question: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) has classified the Indian soil into_______ categories as per the United States Department of Agriculture (the USDA) Soil Taxonomy?
solution:
The correct answer is **__8__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Indian Council of Agricultural Research,** eight types** of soils are found in India.
 
• **On the basis of genesis,** color, composition, and location, the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) has classified soils into **8 categories**.
 
 
• Alluvial Soil
 
• Black Cotton Soil
 
• Red Soil
 
• Laterite Soil
 
• Mountainous or Forest Soils
 
• Arid or Desert Soil
 
• Saline and Alkaline Soil
 
• Peaty, and Marshy Soil/Bog Soil
 
 
 
• The** USDA Soil Taxonomy System** has six levels of classification, from most general to most specific.
 
• The levels are: **Order, Suborder, Great Group, Subgroup, Family, and Series.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Soil **is the mixture of rock debris and organic materials which develop on the earth’s surface. 
 
• The** Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)** is an autonomous body responsible for co-ordinating agricultural education and research in India.
 
• The **Union Minister of Agriculture serves as its president.**
 
• **It is the largest network of agricultural research** and education institutes in the world
